dsh-workspace-memory
Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff for DeepSeek Harness.

One confirmation. One model call. No silent background calls.
Category: Memory & Context · License:

MIT · Install: npm 0.1.2 / GitHub source
English | 中文
Watch the full 24-second demo (MP4)
## The problem
A project is often spread across many DeepSeek Harness conversations. When you open a fresh conversa
tion in the same working directory, the new agent does not know what the previous one did. You end u
p re-explaining the goal, the decisions, the files, and what is still pending.
[该节后续省略]
## Why it is different
| Principle | What it means in practice |
| **No silent model calls** | The plugin never calls a model on page load, panel open, session creat
ion, turn end, a timer, or a failed request. The only model-call path is the confirmed **Inject memo

ry** action. |
| **Spend before you send** | Before anything is sent, the confirmation dialog shows
the source conversations, the curator model, estimated input tokens, the output limit, and estimated

injection tokens. It also states that the project summary will be sent to the model provider. |
| *
*Exactly one call per confirmation** | The curator call both curates the older conversations and pro
duces the injected brief. Injection itself is local and does not call the model. No hidden second ca

ll. |
| **Project-scoped, not global** | The project root is resolved from the session's working dir
ectory: registered DSH workspace root, nearest Git root, then the directory itself. Subdirectory ses

sions share the project; different projects stay isolated. |
| **A one-shot handoff, not an always-o
n memory OS** | There is no background capture, no per-turn recall, no vector database, and no model
-facing memory tool. Use it when you open a new conversation; the rest of the time it costs zero tok

ens. |
| **Compaction-aware** | When an earlier conversation has a DSH compaction summary, the plugi
n reuses it instead of re-reading the raw transcript. That is already-paid-for context and usually h

igher quality than a naive tail. |
| **Your notes stay yours** | Pinned `notes.md` are inserted verb

atim. The curator model is told not to rewrite them and is not allowed to replace them. |
| **Zero n
ative dependencies** | Pure Node.js ESM. No SQLite, no ONNX runtime, no embedding model download, no

build-script approval. The stored state is a few plain files. |
| **Fail closed, no surprise retry*
* | If the curator route fails, times out, or returns an invalid brief, the plugin reports the error

and injects nothing. It does not silently retry, switch models, or fall back to another call. |

## How it works
Earlier conversations → local dossier → **Inject memory** → confirmation → one curator call → save/p
repare → first message → normal request.
| # | What happens | Model call? |

| 1 | Find earlier conversations in the same project. | 0 |
| 2 | Read and structure them locally: r

equests, outcomes, files, errors, compaction summaries. | 0 |
| 3 | A new blank conversation shows *

*Inject memory**. Hover for sources, curator model, and token estimates. | 0 |
| 4 | Click: the conf

irmation layer appears. Nothing has been sent to a model yet. | 0 |
| 5 | Confirm: exactly one curat

or call. Input = notes + previous brief + dossier. Output = one bounded Markdown brief. | **1** |
|

6 | Save the brief and prepare the injection. | 0 |
| 7 | Send the first user message: the memory bl

ock is inserted right after it. | 0 |
| 8 | The normal conversation request carries the brief as inp
ut tokens. | normal request |
The injected block is a regular DSH `user/message` with a source kind of `workspace-memory`. It is f
ramed as **untrusted background**, not instructions:

## Screenshots
## Quick start
### Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (the adapter uses the current Host APIs).
- Node.js `>=22.1

9.0` (the DSH runtime requirement).
- A working DSH model route. The default curator uses the curren
t conversation's model; you can override it per project.
## Privacy and security

- Memory state is local: `~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<project-hash>/`.
- Stored files are `brief.md`, `
notes.md`, and `state.json`. The plugin does not store full transcripts, reasoning, images, or raw t

ool output.
- Only when you confirm **Curate and inject** does the project dossier go to the selecte

d model provider. The confirmation says so explicitly.
- The injected block is marked as untrusted h

istorical background. Treat it as stale and verify it against the files.
- The plugin adds no teleme
try of its own and makes no network requests except the confirmed curator call through DSH's `llm` s

ervice.
- This is trusted Host code. Review the source before installing, as with any DSH plugin.
## What this plugin is not
It is intentionally **not** a general memory OS. It does not do automatic recall on every turn, back
ground capture, embeddings/vector search, multi-modal memory, memory tools, skill evolution, multi-a
gent sharing, or cloud sync. If you want those capabilities, use a dedicated memory system — for exa
mple the MemOS DeepSeek Harness adapter, which auto-recalls and captures, or another plugin from the
Awesome DSH Plugin list.
Do not enable two automatic injectors on the same project/workspace unless you have planned for dupl
icate context and token cost. This plugin's value is the opposite trade-off: **explicit, bounded, au
ditable, and silent by default**.
## Compatibility and status

- Tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` on macOS (Desktop Web profile).
- Node.js `>=22.19.0`.
- No native de

pendency, no build step, no embedding model download.
- The client bundle requires `remote.commands`

(declared in its `inject` list).
- The plugin is a DSH bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch` plus a Web client

module.
- This is an early `0.1.x` release. If a DSH preview changes a Host API, the plugin may nee
d an update; pin a known-good release if you need stability.
